tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (16.5:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: patriot-navy
tokens.usage: Service, duty, commitment. Used as text on `.org-emblem`, `.metric-card.gold .metric-icon`, `.metric-value`. 16.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: honor-gold
tokens.usage: Valor, achievement, recognition. Used as text on `.header-stat-value`, `.honor-roll-title`, `.branch-count`; border on `.metric-card.gold`. 3.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: cream-white
tokens.usage: Peace, purity, new beginnings. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: deep-navy
tokens.usage: Authority, respect, tradition. Used as text on `body`, `.event-description`, `.project-description`. 16.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: courage-red
tokens.usage: Sacrifice, bravery, important notices. Used as border on `.metric-card.red`, `.event-card.ceremony`.

tokens.name: silver-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.metric-label`, `.metric-change.neutral`, `.event-month`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Service, duty, commitment. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: honor-name-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.honor-name`, `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.header-stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.event-meta` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.sample: View Full Calendar RSVP for Events
styles.usage: Button labels — as `div.action-buttons` on the reference page.
